name: mordred-flawless-blade-floating-payment-accepts-non-floating-card
notes: Mordred, Flawless Blade (WI2owxIw0z): only attack cards in the graveyard have floating memory, and the floating payment prompt offers just those. ENGINE BUG (found, confirmed live, NOT fixed): the prompt is an MZMULTICHOOSE ("0|1|myGraveyard-1") and GameValidateDecisionAnswer() (Custom/GameLogic.php) only validates MZCHOOSE/MZMAYCHOOSE answers against the candidate pool, so an answer that was never offered is passed straight to the PAYFLOATING handler. Same setup as mordred-flawless-blade-attack-card-in-graveyard-floats-for-levelup, but the answer is the Dungeon Guide (myGraveyard-0), which was NOT offered and has no floating memory: the engine banishes it as a floating payment and the level-up completes. The REGRESSION GUARD assertions pin that outcome (rules-correct: the answer is rejected and the prompt stays pending).

rulesClauses: Only a card WITH floating memory may be banished as a floating payment.

engineBug.summary: The floating-payment prompt (an MZMULTICHOOSE such as '0|1|myGraveyard-1') is not validated: GameValidateDecisionAnswer() (Custom/GameLogic.php) only checks MZCHOOSE/MZMAYCHOOSE answers against the candidate pool, so an answer that was never offered (a Dungeon Guide with no floating memory) is passed to the PAYFLOATING handler and banished as a floating payment. Confirmed live: the replayed level-up completes with the Dungeon Guide banished and the offered Striking Tides left in the graveyard.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php GameValidateDecisionAnswer() (type filter skips MZMULTICHOOSE) -> PAYFLOATING custom handler
engineBug.verification: Root cause confirmed live with a temporary file trace (restored afterwards): GameValidateDecisionAnswer logged type=MZMULTICHOOSE param=0|1|myGraveyard-1 answer=myGraveyard-0 and let it through. Break/restore: validating MZMULTICHOOSE answers against the candidate list flipped this guard red ('Invalid selection.') while the legitimate floating payments (Flawless Blade, Dredging Streams) stayed green; restored, shasums verified.
